## Universal Acceleration & Innovation Protocol (UAIP) Launch Checklist

### 1. Objective + Leverage
- [ ] Outcome in terms of compounding advantage, not just features.
- [ ] Downstream benefits listed (time, risk, uniqueness, scale).

### 2. Ruthless Automation
- [ ] Manual tasks identified and scheduled for immediate automation.
- [ ] Idempotency and fault-tolerance by design.

### 3. Interoperability & Reuse
- [ ] Modular primitives (not scripts), clear interfaces and doc.

### 4. Data-Driven Feedback Loops
- [ ] Observability/metrics from day one.
- [ ] Feedback loop/adaptation plan present.

### 5. Benchmarking & Continuous Improvement
- [ ] Solution benchmarked vs. best in class/exemplars.
- [ ] Codified patterns, failures, and wins in a living playbook.

### 6. Ecosystem Leverage
- [ ] Ready for external collab/handoff.
- [ ] OSS/network effects enabled.

### 7. Inspiration & Culture
- [ ] "What if…" mindset; radical alternatives explored.
- [ ] Shared, prototyped, reviewed.
